title: Raven portable log catalog v1
description: An explicit catalog of a run's logs. Raven reads this manifest when logs.manifest_file identifies it for the selected job. Relative paths resolve against this manifest's directory, including explicit ../ sibling locations; exact absolute external paths are supported. No glob or recursive discovery is implied.

job_id.description: If supplied, this must exactly equal the selected Slurm job ID, including its array-task or heterogeneous-job component.

id.description: Stable, unique within this manifest. Native validation enforces ID uniqueness.

path.description: An exact POSIX path. Relative paths are normalized against the manifest directory; absolute paths may identify another explicit location. No tilde expansion, globs, backslashes, or terminal controls. Native validation also checks the resolved path length and deduplicates resolved paths.

$comment: The native reader requires a stable regular UTF-8 file of at most 262144 bytes and rejects duplicate JSON keys, duplicate log IDs, mismatched job_id, controls, and non-finite JSON. Scheduler stdout/stderr are added automatically; duplicate resolved paths appear once. Catalogs contain at most 256 entries including scheduler and discovered logs; any omission is reported visibly. Availability and readability are checked when a selected log is opened.
